posts.title: Nio Hong Kong shares plunge 9% as August deliveries show Onvo weakness
posts.summary:
Nio's Hong Kong-listed shares fell to their lowest since July 2025. The company is set to report second-quarter results hours later.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio's Hong Kong shares fell over 9% as investors reacted to August delivery data that highlighted significant weakness in the Onvo sub-brand.
While the main Nio brand grew 101.18% year-on-year, the Onvo brand experienced a 46.39% year-on-year decline and a 13.24% sequential drop.
The market reaction underscores investor anxiety regarding the execution of Nio's multi-brand strategy and the sustainability of its overall delivery growth trajectory.

posts.title: BYD August sales rise 17.8% to 440,293 as overseas sales hit new record
posts.summary:
BYD sold 440,293 NEVs in August, posting a fourth consecutive year-on-year increase and its highest monthly total this year.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD recorded 440,293 NEV sales in August, marking its highest monthly total for 2026 and a 17.84% year-on-year increase.
The company's growth is heavily reliant on international expansion, with overseas sales hitting a record 189,466 units, up 134.5% compared to the previous year.
While passenger NEV sales grew 5.43% sequentially, the data highlights a stark contrast between robust international demand and a 14.3% year-on-year decline in domestic sales.

posts.title: Nio Q2 2026 earnings call: Live updates
posts.summary:
The third-generation ES8 is expected to reach its 150,000th delivery this month, and demand remains very strong.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio is spinning off its physical AI division into a startup while retaining a strategic stake, allowing the company to pursue embodied intelligence without impacting its core P&L.
Rising material costs for components like memory and batteries increased the average cost per vehicle by 14,000 yuan in Q2, with further cost pressures expected in the second half of the year.
The company is negotiating external battery-swap partnerships and expects subscription revenue from driver-assistance features to become a significant long-term income stream.

posts.title: Roundup: August 2026 deliveries by major Chinese automakers
posts.summary:
Leapmotor and Zeekr continued to set records, while Xpeng and Li Auto returned to sequential growth.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Chinese NEV makers showed significant divergence in August 2026, with Leapmotor and Zeekr setting records while Huawei HIMA faced its third consecutive year-on-year decline.
BYD maintained market dominance with 440,293 sales, driven largely by a 134.45% year-on-year surge in overseas markets, which now account for over 43% of its total volume.
Xpeng and Li Auto returned to sequential growth, while Nio sustained delivery volumes above 35,000 units for the fourth straight month despite ongoing pressure on its Onvo sub-brand.

posts.title: Research Bits: Sept. 1
posts.summary:
Gallium nitride: High voltage; low resistance; diamond interposer.
The post Research Bits: Sept. 1 appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: EPFL researchers developed an intrinsic polarization superjunction (iPSJ) GaN transistor on silicon that achieves a record 4kV breakdown voltage while maintaining low resistance.
The iPSJ design avoids charge imbalance by balancing positive and electron charge sheets, eliminating the need for traditional chemical doping and improving reliability under high-temperature stress.
A separate research collaboration achieved a breakthrough in p-type GaN contact resistivity, reaching (1–3) × 10⁻⁴ Ω cm² by depositing an ultrathin magnesium layer and annealing at 600°C.
These advancements in GaN technology are critical for improving the efficiency and thermal robustness of next-generation power electronics, particularly for electric vehicles and industrial systems.
